mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, email, phone, password, avatar, sex, status, last_login_time, last_login_ip, tenant_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted, version FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = FALSE AND tenant_id = COALESCE(#{tenantId}, '000000') LIMIT 1
SELECT r.id, r.name, r.code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = FALSE
